hero.heading: Honor band auditions, without the tabulation room.
hero.subhead: Judges score on a tablet or laptop, your score room watches every room fill in, and each school director sees their own results when you publish. $199 a year for your district.

day.heading: Audition day, from setup to results

steps.title: Set up your rooms
steps.body: Name each judging room, set how many judges sit in it, and choose the instruments it hears and their score sheets. Then import your roster from a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Print judge logins
steps.body: Print a login sheet for every judge and staff seat. Judges don't need accounts, and their logins stop working a week after you publish results.

steps.title: Check in and score
steps.body: Registration checks students in by audition number and adds walk-ins. Judges score on any tablet or laptop and sign each sheet.

steps.title: Watch and correct
steps.body: The score room sees which rooms are behind and every signed sheet as it comes in. A correction keeps the original score and the reason.

steps.title: Place and publish
steps.body: Rank each instrument with ties flagged, seat your honor bands, fill the state's scoring workbook, and publish. Each school director sees only their school's results.

items.q: Who sees students' names and scores?
items.a: Your district's organizers see the whole event. Judges see the auditions in their own room, by audition number. Each school director sees only their own school's results, after you publish.

items.q: Can we set up our own rooms and score sheets?
items.a: Yes. Before you import the roster, you set the rooms, how many judges sit in each, and which instruments each room hears with which score sheet. The sheets cover major scales, the chromatic scale, the étude and sight-reading, and percussion's snare, mallets and timpani.

items.q: What happens to student information afterward?
items.a: You choose: it's deleted 6, 12 or 24 months after you publish results, or kept until you delete it. Download what you need first.

items.q: Can our district pay by purchase order?
items.a: Yes. We'll send a quote, an invoice and a W-9.

items.q: Is Program Partner part of GMEA?
items.a: No. Program Partner is an independent company. Its score room is built for the way GMEA districts run honor band auditions.
